question: Does active-order sponsorship during the final contraction or on the breakout day distinguish durable VCP demand from failed release?

moneyflow_input.coverage_observed_before_registration: 2015-01-05 through 2026-09-07; 11,337,431 rows; signal-date coverage 94.59%-100% by candidate year
moneyflow_input.contract: Tushare moneyflow field family: volumes in round lots and amounts in ten-thousand yuan. Use net_mf_amount divided by the sum of same-row order-size amounts, so the feature is dimensionless and does not depend on daily-bar amount units.
moneyflow_input.provenance_limit: 2015 through part of 2026 is retained under quanti.stock_moneyflow_raw lineage; later rows are tushare.pro.moneyflow. The audit is isolated research evidence, not a TickFlow production dataset publication.

causal_features.final_leg_net_ratio: Sum net_mf_amount from the recorded pivot date through the trading day before the signal, divided by the sum of all buy/sell size-bucket amounts in the same rows.
causal_features.final_leg_positive_day_share: Share of covered final-leg sessions with positive net_mf_amount.
causal_features.signal_day_net_ratio: Signal-day net_mf_amount divided by the sum of signal-day buy/sell size-bucket amounts; known at the completed close before next-open execution.

method: Compare continuous distributions, yearly pairwise ranking probability, annual-within-year quintiles, and Spearman association with 40-day return. No cutoff, score, classifier, strategy rule or portfolio backtest.
decision_rule: Support the mechanism only if at least one feature is directionally positive overall, positive in at least 7 of 10 candidate years, has top-minus-bottom annual-within-year quintile breakout rate of at least 5 percentage points, and has positive Spearman association with 40-day return. Otherwise stop the moneyflow gate/rank direction without window variants.
anti_overfit: Do not select absolute net-flow thresholds or top-percentile cutoffs.
Do not combine the three features into a score.
Do not run a portfolio backtest unless the pre-registered mechanism gate passes.
